front.title: Apple HomeView available today
front.tldr: Apple's new HomeView smart home display went on sale today, a single hub for entertainment, communication and managing the home.

front.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
front.tldr: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting its agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

front.title: Tom Brady surprised a Boston bride on her wedding day
front.tldr: Tom Brady turned up for a lifelong Patriots fan on her wedding day, posing for a photo with the bride before she said her vows.

stories.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
stories.tldr: LangChain has reached a $3bn valuation, with the company citing 7,000 customers of LangSmith, its model and platform agnostic tool for managing AI agents.

stories.title: ElevenLabs' new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
stories.tldr: ElevenLabs has launched ElevenAI, a meeting notetaker and dictation app aimed at teams and enterprises, extending the company's voice AI work.

stories.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
stories.tldr: Shield's Forge agents, built on OpenAI, now navigate legacy IT portals so technicians can focus on the issues that need their own judgement.

stories.title: llm-gemini 0.37
stories.tldr: Simon Willison updated his llm-gemini plugin for Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google's new low-cost Gemini 4 model, priced not far off its bigger siblings.

stories.title: Amazon's new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
stories.tldr: The new Kindle Colorsoft is lighter and thinner than its predecessor with an edge-to-edge display, though first-generation owners have little reason to upgrade.

stories.title: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean's heat
stories.tldr: Drogue is harvesting ocean heat to power floating data centres, with a first prototype expected on the water within two years and investors already on board.

stories.title: Whoop Humans is a social network designed for fitness enthusiasts
stories.tldr: Whoop, maker of screenless fitness trackers, has launched its own social network, Whoop Humans, for members to share workouts and progress.

stories.title: Some physical copies of GTA VI can allegedly be redeemed without opening the box
stories.tldr: Some international physical copies of GTA VI can reportedly be redeemed without opening the box, making the packaging purely decorative.

stories.title: iOS 27.3 adds three features I've used almost every day
stories.tldr: 9to5Mac flags three features in the iOS 27.3 beta, due next month, that its writer has used almost daily since testing began.

stories.title: Apple Maps in iOS 27 has a hidden feature worth loving
stories.tldr: Of the features iOS 27 added to Apple Maps, 9to5Mac singles out Local Lists, which keeps surfacing fresh updates every week, as its favourite.

stories.title: iPhone Duo survives 450,000 folds, but its hinge is weakening
stories.tldr: Three weeks into a CNET livestream stress test, the iPhone Duo has passed 451,000 folds, though its hinge is now showing signs of wear.

stories.title: Production designer Ruth De Jong on how to build ancient worlds for auteurs
stories.tldr: Ruth De Jong talks IndieWire through designing The Odyssey, and her earlier work for David Lynch, Paul Thomas Anderson and Terrence Malick.

stories.title: Seth Rogen on The Invite, Tangles and the best advice he ever got
stories.tldr: At the Middleburg Film Festival, Seth Rogen talks to Variety about The Invite, Tangles, The Studio season two and reviving Darkwing Duck.

stories.title: IndieWire Honors will celebrate John Turturro, the Artificial cast and more
stories.tldr: IndieWire Honors will mark the year in film with awards for John Turturro, Andrew Garfield, Yura Borisov, Monica Barbaro and others.

stories.title: Margot Robbie to star in A24's The Week of Pain
stories.tldr: Margot Robbie will star in The Week of Pain, from The Drama director Kristoffer Borgli, her first time leading a film for A24.

stories.title: Patriots look to bounce back against the Lions in Munich
stories.tldr: Coming off a heavy loss to the Packers, the Patriots face Dan Campbell's one-loss Lions in Munich on Sunday, looking to show they can beat a strong opponent.

stories.title: Hundreds of Scotland's Tartan Army set to attend the Patriots' game in Germany
stories.tldr: Hundreds of members of Scotland's Tartan Army plan to attend Sunday's Patriots-Lions game in Munich, calling it a chance to revisit the city.

stories.title: James Allison reveals the trick behind Kimi Antonelli's F1 title
stories.tldr: Mercedes technical director James Allison explains how Kimi Antonelli's bold use of his steering wheel tools helped him become F1's youngest world champion.

stories.title: Las Vegas GP reveals neon sign-inspired trophy design
stories.tldr: The Las Vegas Grand Prix has unveiled a new winners' trophy, a 3.6kg, 56cm design inspired by the city's neon lights that took six months to develop.

stories.title: Why are F1 drivers obsessed with padel?
stories.tldr: Padel has become increasingly popular among F1 drivers, with Aston Martin the latest team to back the sport through a new racket collection.

stories.title: Bauers agrees to four-year deal with the Red Sox
stories.tldr: Jake Bauers, a postseason breakout star for the Brewers, has agreed to a four-year deal with the Red Sox, a source tells MLB.com.
